verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `cli` subcommand that can spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes in a running instance. That gives a scriptable way to build a workspace layout, and it fits the story's "or scripts" path. It also has a Lua config file and pane splitting, but nothing in the pack shows the config declaring startup sessions or layouts. missing for 10: documented config-level startup session/layout definition (e.g. startup hooks or workspace definitions), evidence of a single-command project workspace launch, hands-on corroboration of scripted layout creation.
